title: Decoupled Temporal Encoding for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Positional encoding is a fundamental component of Transformer-based generative recommendation models, where user histories are modeled as autoregressive item sequences. Most positional encoding methods are inherited from natural language processing and mainly represent discrete item order. However, recommendation sequences go beyond ordered lists, as timestamps and temporal effects also shape item relations. Our work is motivated by a real-world food delivery and instant retail recommendation system, where user behavior exhibits multi-level temporal regularities, including recency effects, meal-time peaks, weekday-weekend shifts, and promotion-driven traffic bursts. translated_title: 解耦时间编码用于生成式推荐
translated_abstract: 位置编码是基于Transformer的生成式推荐模型的基本组成部分，其中用户历史被建模为自回归物品序列。大多数位置编码方法继承自自然语言处理，主要表示离散的物品顺序。然而，推荐序列不仅仅是有序列表，因为时间戳和时间效应也塑造了物品关系。我们的工作受到一个真实世界的食品配送和即时零售推荐系统的启发，其中用户行为表现出多层次的时间规律性，包括近期效应、用餐时间高峰、工作日-周末变化以及促销驱动的流量激增。现有方法通过时间戳特征、间隔嵌入、衰减函数或注意力偏置部分解决了这个问题，但它们通常通过统一表示或单一建模路径注入异质的时间信号，这使得难以...
tldr: 本文提出了一种解耦时间编码方法，针对生成式推荐中多层次时间规律性难以统一建模的问题，通过分离不同时间信号来提升推荐性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a decoupled temporal encoding method to address the challenge of modeling multi-level temporal regularities in generative recommendation by separating heterogeneous temporal signals.
